notes: Infernal Scarring (M21): 'Enchant creature. Enchanted creature gets +2/+0 and has "When this creature dies, draw a card."' Cast on seat 0's Bear (4/2). The Bear is dealt 2 and dies: its granted trigger makes its controller (seat 0) draw one card (hand 0 -> 1); the Aura goes to the graveyard; seat 1 draws nothing.
